svg.title: How One Founder Builds a Live Sports Platform Without a Database Team
svg.desc: A typographic quote card: Gabriel Gil Graña of Xeito on wanting to spend his time creating features instead of managing memory, pool connections, storage limits, replicas and backups. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, prism yellow accent.

g.text: I really wanted to spend time creating features

text.tspan: and not having to deal with memory, pool connections,
